== Summary ==
Decipher's revised errata for Self-Destruct Mechanism: the entry “Self-Destruct Mechanism” in Decipher's ''Star Wars CCG Glossary Supplement'' (updated 29 January 2002), PDF page 7. Image for [[Self-Destruct Mechanism (Decipher Errata 2002)]].

Wiki copy of the source: [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf|Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf]] (SHA-1 <code>3f9a040eca571154b142ffc52e3ac36f16045c02</code>). Cut unchanged from a 300 dpi render of PDF page 7 (pdftoppm -r 300), around the entry's title and revised game text with a 6-point margin.
